privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: Grundtone Studio is a platform for configuring and distributing design tokens. We process the minimum personal data required to deliver that service. This page summarises what we collect, why, how long we keep it, and how to contact us.
privacy.controller: ASP Productions ApS, CVR pending — operating as KlangHaus. The data controller is responsible for what's described below; for questions, write to the contact address at the bottom.

data.account: Account data: name, email, hashed password (Better Auth). Used to authenticate and to label content you create.
data.session: Session data: a strictly necessary session cookie + the IP address and user-agent of your login. Used to keep you signed in and to detect suspicious activity.
data.tokens: Project data: design tokens, version history, API keys (hashed), member roles. Stored to deliver the product.
data.cdn: CDN access logs: API key prefix, origin, request timing. Retained 30 days for abuse detection.

privacy.legal: Contract (delivering Studio to you) for account, session, and project data. Legitimate interest (security + abuse prevention) for access logs. We do not run marketing tracking and have no advertising cookies.

retention.account: Account data: until you delete the account, then deleted within 30 days.
retention.session: Sessions: 30 days of inactivity, then expired automatically.
retention.tokens: Project data: kept while the org exists. Deleting the org cascades.

privacy.rights: You can request access, correction, deletion, restriction, and data portability under GDPR. We respond within one month. Write to the contact address below or use the account page in Studio (/account).
privacy.subProcessors: We use a small set of EU-located processors to operate Studio. The full list is at

dpa.title: Data processing agreement
dpa.intakeBody: This page is a public template covering what our DPA contains. To get a signed copy on your company letterhead, write to
dpa.intro: This template summarises the Data Processing Agreement (DPA) Grundtone (ASP Productions ApS) offers to organisations that use Studio as a data processor under GDPR art. 28. The full signable contract is provided on request.
dpa.scope: Grundtone acts as data processor for design tokens, organisation membership data, and project content that your team uploads. You remain the data controller for that data.

processing.purpose: Purpose: deliver Studio's design-token configuration and CDN distribution service.
processing.duration: Duration: until contract termination or your written request to delete.
processing.dataTypes: Data types: account info, design tokens, API keys (hashed), CDN access logs.
processing.subjects: Data subjects: your organisation's admins, designers, and end users whose browsers fetch tokens via your API key.

security.encryption: TLS in transit, AES-256 at rest on UpCloud Managed Postgres + Object Storage.
security.access: Role-based access: only authorised KlangHaus personnel can access production systems; access is logged.
security.audit: Audit log of admin actions retained for 12 months.
security.incident: Personal data breach notification to you within 72 hours of discovery.

dpa.subProcessors: We use the EU-located sub-processors listed at
dpa.termination: On termination, all your data is deleted from production systems within 30 days. Backups are purged on their normal rotation, max 90 days. A deletion certificate is available on request.
dpa.law: Danish law. Disputes go to the Court of Copenhagen unless mandatory consumer-protection rules apply differently.

subProcessors.title: Sub-processors
subProcessors.intro: Grundtone uses the following EU-located sub-processors to operate Studio. Each provider has its own DPA + GDPR commitments — links below.
subProcessors.notification: We notify customers 30 days before adding a new sub-processor unless an urgent security replacement is required. Material objections can lead to contract termination per the DPA.

upcloud.role: Application hosting, Managed PostgreSQL, Object Storage

bunny.role: CDN edge caching for /k/ endpoints (public API key in URL)

github.role: Source code hosting + CI; no production customer data

integrationGuide.sriHeading: Production: pin a version + use Sub-Resource Integrity
integrationGuide.sriBody: For long-lived production deploys, pin to an immutable version URL and add an SRI hash. The corresponding hash is served at the same path with a .sri suffix.

apiKeys.title: API keys
apiKeys.whatIsItTooltip: An API key (pk_live_…) is a publishable token your customer app uses to fetch this project's design tokens. It's safe to ship in client code — like Stripe's pk_live keys. Lock it to specific origins below to limit who can use it.
apiKeys.allowedOriginsHelp: One per line, e.g. 'acme.com' or '*.acme.com'. Empty = any origin allowed.
apiKeys.rateLimitHelp: Per-key cap enforced by the CDN endpoint. 1000 covers a typical landing page; raise it for high-traffic sites.

roleDescriptions.owner: Unrestricted access to the organization, its data, and its settings. Can add, modify, and delete projects and members, as well as make billing and plan changes.
roleDescriptions.manager: Gains admin access on all projects as well as the ability to add and remove organization members.
roleDescriptions.admin: Admin privileges on projects they are a member of. They can create new projects, and remove projects they hold membership on. They can manage memberships of projects they are members of. By default they can invite members to the organization.
roleDescriptions.member: Members can view most data within the organization and act on the projects they are added to. By default they can invite members to the organization.
roleDescriptions.billing: Can manage subscription and billing details.
